sql:
SELECT
  stores_src_10000.region AS store__region
  , SUM(subq_3.__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    store_id AS store
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_enriched_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_3
LEFT OUTER JOIN
  "data"."main"."stores" stores_src_10000
ON
  subq_3.store = stores_src_10000.store_id
GROUP BY
  stores_src_10000.region
